What if a box jellyfish stung you?
Meet the box jellyfish. Almost invisible.
It has 24 eyes... but no brain!
Up to 60 tentacles, each up to 3 meters long.
Covered in millions of tiny harpoons.
Brush against one... and they fire!
Faster than almost anything in nature.
The pain? Among the worst on Earth.
A big sting can stop a heart in minutes.
But most stings are not deadly.
Step one: get out and call for help.
Then pour on vinegar. Lots of it!
Never rub it. Skip the fresh water.
That's why swimmers wear stinger suits.
